subject: Post-call: Exec recap & next steps (OrfIntel)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@orfintel.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Exec recap & next steps (OrfIntel)

Hi Jill —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our exec-level discussion and the asks you flagged: 

Key business outcomes OrfIntel is targeting
- Improve customer support resolution time by 30% through automated summarization and suggested responses
- Reduce search/lookup time for case handlers (goal: 40% faster time-to-answer)
- Consolidate vendor set for inference workloads to lower per-token costs and simplify compliance

Primary pain points called out
- Current latency on on-prem model ops prevents real-time assists for agents (95th percentile spikes)
- Procurement and security need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an itemized data flow for audit
- Legacy ticketing integration has rate limits that impact batching strategies

Immediate asks / next steps
1) I attached the post-call deck with the proposed pilot scope and success metrics (postcall-orfintel-deck.pdf).
2) Jill to share procurement contacts + target procurement timeline (T+30 days?).
3) Redwood to provide SOC2 evidence, network/dataflow diagram, and a short ops runbook for the pilot.
4) Schedule a pilot kickoff with Mark Reynolds (CIO) + procurement + engineering. Proposed date range: Apr 12–16.

Risks and proposed mitigations
- Risk: SOC2 evidence and contractual SLRs may slow procurement. Mitigation: share existing SOC2 report and offer a 30-day compliance review window; propose a pilot with limited PHI scope and strict KMS-based key management.
- Risk: Latency spikes on on-prem. Mitigation: propose a hybrid route (hosted + dedicated burst) and initial traffic shaping for the pilot.

Ownership
- Laura (me): pilot scope, executive coordination, pricing proposal
- Aditya: procurement / commercial lead + pricing package
- Sean: CSM / pilot success metrics and onboarding

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the SOC2 packet and a suggested commercial term sheet by EOD Tuesday.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: postcall-orfintel-deck.pdf

From: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@orfintel.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@orfintel.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Exec recap & next steps (OrfIntel)

Laura —

Appreciate the thorough recap. Correct on the outcomes and thanks for the clear ownership. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Procurement timeline: our internal target is to have vendor selection completed by Apr 30. Procurement needs an initial SOW and the SOC 2 packet by next week to kick off legal review.
- Exec sponsor: Mark Reynolds (CIO) will own sign-off on the pilot and final budget. I’ll loop him on the kickoff thread once we have proposed dates.
- Security: we will need network/dataflow diagrams and a list of data elements that will be processed during the pilot (PII/PHI flags).

I attached a draft SOW that outlines a proposed 6-week pilot; please review and flag areas you want to modify (OrfIntel-SOW-draft.docx).

Proposed next steps
1) Redwood to send SOC2 + dataflow + runbook by EOD Thursday (Apr 1).
2) Procurement to review SOW; I’ll introduce procurement lead (Angela Park) on Thursday.
3) Schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff with Mark and engineering for week of Apr 12.

Thanks — I’ll await the SOC2 packet and the short runbook.

Best,
Jill Thompson
Head of Product Operations
OrfIntel
jill.thompson@orfintel.com
Attachment: OrfIntel-SOW-draft.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_coole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Exec recap: OrfIntel — SOC2 + procurement path (FYI / action items)

Marissa / Aditya —

FYI following the call with OrfIntel (Jill + Mark incoming). Key items that need leadership support: 

1) SOC2 packet and evidence (legal/compliance ask). Aditya — please confirm we can share the redacted SOC2 Type II report and the standard Attestation Letter by EOD Thu. If there are any gating additional artifacts (pen tests, dataflow), flag them.

2) Commercial / pricing: OrfIntel is expecting vendor selection by Apr 30. They will likely move forward with a pilot procurement. We should present a clean pilot pricing sheet and an enterprise term that includes: 6-week pilot (fixed price option + usage overage), standard SLAs for response/uptime, and an option to convert to a Dedicated contract.

3) Executive engagement: Mark Reynolds (CIO) will be the signer for the pilot. We should offer a 15-min prep with Mark prior to kickoff to align on success metrics. Laura will coordinate scheduling.

4) Escalation: procurement may request a one-time credit or extended payment terms as part of pilot approval. I recommend we keep credits limited to pilot performance milestones (e.g., credit if SLA not met) rather than unconditional discounts.

Action owners
- Aditya: confirm SOC2 artifacts + draft pilot pricing by EOD Thu Apr 1
- Sean: final pilot success metrics doc and onboarding checklist by Apr 5
- Marissa: if you want to review the pricing approach before it goes to Jill, I can drop a short note into your calendar Fri morning.

I’ll assemble the packet and share the HubSpot deal link and DocuSign draft in my follow-up.

Thanks,
Laura
